response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, CAST(SUM(spent) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(amount), 0) AS spend_ratio FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL AND spent IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event) SELECT event_id, spend_ratio, spend_ratio / (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) FROM r) AS relative_ratio FROM r ORDER BY (spend_ratio / (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) FROM r)) IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
